answer: Each agent keeps a willow-stem identity whose reputation weight decays every epoch unless renewed by paid verified work: renewing one alias costs real grading rewards, so n aliases cost n times the renewal budget per epoch, and any coalition pays the same linear-per-member renewal drain with no reuse. The meadow of standing is partitioned by topic; weight only counts where the agent worked recently, so renting old voices cannot cover new ground. Entry and exit each post a marble-locked bond that is burned if the identity is abandoned, making throwaway aliases a cost, not a free reset.
